metadata.title: Linking-form splitting and four-dimensional genera of knots
metadata.abstract: By Gilmer's splitting lemma, the linking form of a rational homology sphere that bounds a 4-manifold is the orthogonal sum of a metabolic summand and a summand presented by a form of the rank of the intersection form. The lemma underlies Gilmer's slice genus theorem and the rank criteria of Murakami-Yasuhara and Gilmer-Livingston for nonorientable surfaces and the 4-dimensional clasp number. We show that the lemma and these results, as stated, are false. For each prime $p \equiv 3 \pmod 8$ we construct knots bounding smooth Möbius bands, and knots bounding smooth punctured tori with clasp number one, whose linking forms have no such summand of rank at most two. We then determine what remains true: the lemma holds up to Witt equivalence and for cube-free orders, and its conclusions about summands hold away from exceptional primes and for orientable surfaces of genus at least two. Finally, we find the optimal Witt-class bound for the topological nonorientable 4-genus.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 连结形式分裂引理的反例与修正
analysis.workSummary: 作者称 Gilmer 连结形式分裂引理及据其得到的若干 slice genus、非定向曲面与四维 clasp 秩判据按原陈述为假。对 p≡3 mod8 的素数，构造界光滑 Möbius 带的结，以及界 clasp 数为一的光滑穿孔环面的结，其连结形式不含预期秩至多二的直和项。
techniques: Witt 等价与 metabolic 分裂
analysis.breakthrough: 区分仍成立的修正版：Witt 等价层面、无立方因子阶数、避开例外素数的直和结论及亏格至少二的可定向曲面，并给拓扑非定向四亏格的最优 Witt 类界。
analysis.limitations: 需区分真实正交直和项与 Witt 类等价；不能说所有既有 slice genus 结论均失效，作者明确保留多个条件范围。原引理与修正假设须正文逐项核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 明确披露Claude Opus5.5(Anthropic)编写前述计算的Python代码并检查文稿语法。故记computation、writing，不能据代码辅助推断反例构造或整个分裂引理修正来自模型。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.40183v1 · PDF 第37页致谢之前工具说明

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。明确披露Claude Opus5.5(Anthropic)编写前述计算的Python代码并检查文稿语法。故记computation、writing，不能据代码辅助推断反例构造或整个分裂引理修正来自模型。

analysis.priorityReason: 纠正低维拓扑中广用工具具有重要性，但偏结与四维拓扑而非几何 PDE。
